title: MongoDB Agent OTLP Metrics (Elasticsearch)
description: The same agent metrics through the elasticsearch OTLP endpoint - documents in metrics-generic.otel-default, aggregated natively (avg for gauges, max+derivative for counters). Mirrors the prometheus dashboard's panel structure.

panels.title: Metric points received
panels.description: all OTLP metric documents stored in the data stream

panels.title: Global lock time & queue
panels.description: time = derivative of the cumulative counter (ms per bucket); queue = point-in-time by access type

panels.title: Lock acquisitions, waits & deadlocks
panels.description: counters rated via derivative, split by lock type

panels.title: mongod uptime
panels.description: counter averaged per bucket - restarts show as resets

panels.title: Data & storage size (per process)
panels.description: per-database docs: shown as the average value per bucket

panels.title: Agent internals (per agent)
panels.description: the agent's own gauges, grouped by agent version

panels.title: Operation time by type (top)
panels.description: derivative of the top sampler's cumulative counter - series appear while top samples are recorded

panels.title: mongod versions
panels.description: processes per mongod version - version skew shows up here during rolling upgrades

panels.title: agent versions
panels.description: agents per agent version - rollout skew across hosts
